ITEM 1 | Pile of about 28 tan-brown oval pieces, roughly 2.5 to 3 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, with a slightly wrinkled, ridged surface, matte and dry with no sheen or oil. Some pieces show darker brown tips and a few lighter pale patches. Firm, holding shape, heaped in the centre of the plate and covering about a fifth of its surface. | 40

ITEM 2 | Single loose oval piece, about 2.5 cm long, tan-brown with a wrinkled, matte surface, sitting alone on the plate's left side. | 2
